name: Regeria Hope
source:
In Regeria Hope, you play as a female lawyer who must prove her clients innocent of crimes they did not commit, similar to the Phoenix Wright games. It is an episodic game, where your choices affect the story, and new play styles will be available as new episodes become available. There are plans to include a jury, so you must appease jury members to have your client pronounced innocent, and to include ways to increase the replay value of trials by having your decisions in previous trials affect future trials in meaningful ways.

The first trial has you defending a husband whose wife has been poisoned during the wedding reception. Currently, you have the ability to interrupt witnesses and other characters while they are speaking, but be careful, as you have a time limit to solve the case!

[Edited from [url=http://goldengamebarn.com/regeria-hope]official site[/url]]
